notes: 1.5: the People Maker (new kinds of people: hair, hats, beards, faces, clothes, what they hold and say, or ask Claude; islands get residents too), the top bar wraps instead of pushing Release and Play off screen, and "Gives off real light" switches off properly instead of piling up. 1.4: your work is also kept in Documents/Tree Sim 4 Studio (with dated backups), and after an update or a fresh download the Studio offers to bring it back; Ask Claude can do anything with an island: new outlines (long, lobed), walkable islands joined by bridges, new buildings it builds from parts, and the game's props put around it; you can make all of that by hand too. 1.3: move, turn, resize or hide anything the game built (beds, stalls, signs, rocks), with its collisions, label and press-F spot; sculpt your islands' ground with Raise, Lower, Flatten and Erase brushes. 1.2: your trees grow (the Studio shows every tree an island can grow; an island can let every tree grow from the start), Unused and On islands tree lists, trees in the Islands tab with how common each one is, the ecosystem (animals, ground cover, fireflies), the Animal Maker (parts with legs, wings and tails that move, or ask Claude), each island's own materials and axes, and Ask Claude invents all of it with the island. 1.1: the Prop Maker, island features, Ask Claude for islands, your own themes
